violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Establishment is to register a certified food safety manager with RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Application provided during the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

An open employees' beverage container was observed stored in a food preparation area. Employees shall not drink from open beverage containers in order to prevent contamination of their hands, the container, and exposed food. The open beverage was relocated to a non-food preparation area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on both prep units. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/28/2026

Raw animal foods (such as shell eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as pickles) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Eggs were moved to different storage location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025

Various food items in the pizza prep unit were observed held at temperatures ranging from 43-44 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were loaded into unit less than 2 hours prior to inspection and were moved to freezer to rapidly cool. PIC adjusted temperature of prep unit and ambient was observed at 40 degrees Fahrenheit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/15/2025
